description:
Found while building fz-sc8.72. `defmodule Foo.Bar do def me(), do: 1 end` followed by `Foo.Bar.me()` fails on every path with "unresolved direct runtime callee", on the base and new binaries. The callee qualifier goes through lookup_module_path (src/compiler2/world.rs), which walks the namespace segment by segment with no fallback, and nothing binds the first segment `Foo`. Elixir prints 1.

This is the acceptance case for fz-sc8.25 (one module resolution for qualified calls): when qualified callees resolve through resolve_module_name, this works. This ticket holds the probe and the oracle fixture that proves it. Deviation from Elixir; not needed by the distiller.
title: A dotted qualified call reaches a module defined under that dotted name
